description: spa_refresh mirror can ship an embedded SPA with index.html but ZERO hashed assets: remove_stale_entries deletes before copies land, and two overlapping 'just up' runs race the shared dist dir. Evidence 2026-08-25: instance healthy + CLI green while every asset 404'd. Mitigations landed: just-up flock lock (tmp/just-up.lock) and post-deploy smoke (scripts/smoke.nu, fails just up on any red route incl. every index-referenced asset). Structural fix (atomic swap + post-condition) open in fabro-332e.
resolution: partial: lock + smoke guard deployed; atomic swap open in fabro-332e
